sections.content: You know *si* + imperfect subjunctive + conditional from B1 Unit 7. Here you use it for imagined choices about work and time: Si tuviera más tiempo, trabajaría menos.

items.spanish: Si tuviera más tiempo, viajaría más.
items.english: If I had more time, I would travel more.

items.spanish: Si pudiera elegir, dedicaría menos horas al trabajo.
items.english: If I could choose, I would devote fewer hours to work.

items.spanish: Si ganara más dinero, no necesariamente sería más feliz.
items.english: If I earned more money, I would not necessarily be happier.

sections.content: The result can hedge itself, as in no necesariamente sería más feliz: you can imagine a change and still doubt it would help.
